questions_and_answers.question_text: Míngtian dōu yǒu shéi kǎoshì?

answers.answer_text: Who's taking the test tomorrow?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Děng yíxia wǒ gěi ni xiě yíge dānzi.

answers.answer_text: I'll write you a list in a minute.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Bómǔ shuì wǔjiào ne ba?

answers.answer_text: Is your mother taking a [noontime] nap?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Xū, xiǎo shēng diǎnr. Bié bǎ ta chǎoxǐng le.

answers.answer_text: Sh! Keep it down. Don't wake her up.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ kàn zhèicìde shēngyi zěnmeyàng?

answers.answer_text: How do you think business will go this time?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Bù zhīdào. Yào kàn yùnqi le.

answers.answer_text: I don't know. It depends on luck.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒ xiǎng qù mǎi xiē gōngyìpǐn dàihuí Měiguó.

answers.answer_text: I want to go buy some handicrafts to take back to America.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒ zhèr zhènghǎo yǒu jǐjiàn, nǐ dōu dàishang ba.

answers.answer_text: I just happen to have some here. Take them with you.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Hǎoxiàng shi Xiǎo Lǐ cóng ménkǒur guòqu le.

answers.answer_text: That looked like Xiǎo Lǐ who just passed by the door.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ hǎohāorde zài zhèr niàn shū ba! Bié xiǎng dōng xiǎng xīde.

answers.answer_text: You just tend to your studies [properly]! Don't be thinking of this and that.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Qùnián tāde Yīngwén hái shuōde nàme nánting, jīnnián hǎoxiàng hǎoduō le. Shi zěnme huí shi?

answers.answer_text: Last year his English still sounded so awful, but this year it seems a lot better. What happened?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shi zènme huí shi, tā mǔqin téng ta, sòng ta qù Yīngguó niànle yìnián shū.

answers.answer_text: It's this way: his mother dotes on him and sent him to school in England for a year.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Tā hái qù zhǎo Xiǎo Lán gàn shénme, rénjia yòu bù xǐhuan ta!

answers.answer_text: What is he going to see Xiǎo Lán for? After all, she doesn't like him.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ bié jí, wǒ lái quànquan ta.

answers.answer_text: Don't get upset, I'll try to persuade him.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ shuō wǒ gāi bu gāi qù?

answers.answer_text: Do you think I should go?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ kànzhe bàn ba, tīngshuō nèige dìfangr kuài dǎ zhàng le.

answers.answer_text: You do as you see fit, but I hear that there's about to be a war there.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Gāngcái wǒ qù gěi Wáng Dàifu sòngxíng, tā shuō tā yuànyi gěi nín kànkan.

answers.answer_text: Just now when I went to see Dr. Wáng off, he said he would be willing to see you [medically].

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhèi yíxiàzi hǎo le. Děng tā huílai wǒ qù kàn ta.

answers.answer_text: (Now) that's great. I'll go see him when he gets back.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhèige shǎ háizi, zènme dàde shìr yě bu zǎo diǎnr gàosu wo!

answers.answer_text: What a stupid kid, why didn't you tell me about this before, since it's such an important thing.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒ zǎo jiu gēn nín shuōguo, nín wàng le.

answers.answer_text: I did tell you, but you've forgotten.
